Publishing in High Ranked Academic Journals (Politico Vista)

📝 I always thought academic publishing was for professors. Not students like me.
This session proved me completely wrong.
Alhamdulillah — I participated in the session "Publishing in High Ranked Academic Journals: Research Principles and Get Thru Tips" as part of the @Politico Vista Summer Internship Programme 2026 — organized in collaboration with FUUAST Islamabad.

And honestly? This might be one of the most practically valuable sessions I have ever attended.

Because here is a truth nobody tells students early enough — your ideas have the power to contribute to global academic knowledge. Your research, your analysis, your voice — it can sit in international journals alongside the world's leading scholars. But only if you know how the system works.

This session pulled back the curtain completely.
We learned the principles of credible research, how high-ranked journals actually evaluate submissions, what editors look for, what gets rejected immediately, and the insider tips that help good research finally get the recognition it deserves.
I walked away with a completely new understanding of academic publishing — and a quiet but fierce determination to one day see my own research in print. 📖
Because why not? Why should that dream belong only to people who have been in academia for decades? It starts somewhere. And it might as well start now.
Grateful to Dr. Faisal Javaid (Editor-in-Chief, Politico Vista | Head, IR & Mass Comm, FUUAST) and Ms. Shazia Batool (Programme Director) for opening this door for young researchers. 🙏
